label: The direct DeepSeek adapter uses the official DeepSeek API and Messages protocol, registering deepseek-official with built-in DeepSeek models and reasoning defaults.
LLM Gateway should be a hand-declared pi-ai OpenAI chat-completions provider with its own credential reference and model list.
OpenCode Go is a distinct pi-ai catalog provider opencode-go using OPENCODE_API_KEY; its current model catalog lists deepseek-v4.1-flash and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
The gateway and OpenCode Go model identifiers and credentials differ and should remain separate route entries.
OpenCode Go endpoint sources disagree between the Models.dev catalog route and OpenCode’s current public Go docs; the route DSH should call is UNKNOWN pending authorized verification.
Headless has no provider/model selector, so provider choice is profile/default-model or persisted-session state; separate profiles are the clearest candidate for route isolation.
